name: Save Bookmark
description: Named places to come back to, which in a branching story is a reading tool rather than a convenience. A reader who wants to see the other branch should not have to replay four chapters, so bookmarks are multi-slot, named by the reader, and record the passage together with the whole flag state — a bookmark that restores position without state lands you in a scene the story no longer believes in. An automatic chapter bookmark is kept separately from named ones so it can never overwrite work the reader deliberately marked.

inputs.name: autoBookmarkOnChapter
inputs.description: Whether entering a chapter writes an automatic bookmark, kept apart from named ones.

inputs.name: captureFullState
inputs.description: Whether flags are stored with the position. False restores a scene the story no longer believes in.

outputs.name: bookmarks
outputs.description: Saved positions with their names and timestamps.

outputs.name: autoBookmark
outputs.description: The most recent automatic chapter mark.
